description: Change a sprint of a project's board: its name, goal or days. Only what you pass is changed; an empty string clears the goal or a day. Starting is start_sprint's and completing complete_sprint's, not this tool's. Each field that moved is a line in the project's journal. Answers with the sprint as list_sprints gives it and 'changed'. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused or archived. Written in the project's journal under your name.

endDate.description: When it ends: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone. An empty string clears it.

goal.description: A new goal. An empty string removes it.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board holds the sprint, e.g. 'PM'.

sprint.description: The sprint, by name or id from list_sprints.

startDate.description: When it starts: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone. An empty string clears it.

name: update_sprint
title: Update sprint
